title: Update details on an RSA/RCG competency card
summary: You can update your details on your RSA or RCG competency card online if you have changed your name or need to update your contact information.
intro: If you've changed your name or need to update contact details on your competency card, you can do so online. Make sure your current email address or mobile phone number is recorded with Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: You must be able to update your details online if you have changed your name or need to update contact details on your competency card.
what_you_need: Your name and competency card/interim certificate number
One of the following change of name documents (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Enter your card or interim certificate number, and your name.

more_info.text: You can access a digital version of your competency card through the Service NSW app.
Your digital card will be automatically updated once your details have been changed.
If you have completed the Advanced Responsible Conduct of Gambling (ARCG) course:

external_links.text: Find an approved RSA and RCG training course provider

internal_links.text: request a new physical competency card
Apply for an RSA or RCG competency card
Renew an RSA or RCG competency card

faqs.q: What do I need to update my competency card details?
faqs.a: You will need your name and competency card or interim certificate number, your new contact details, and one of the following change of name documents (if applicable): your payment.

faqs.q: How do I update my details online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Update online' button, select 'Start', enter your card or interim certificate number and your name, select 'Next', and then enter the required information.
